messages:
security-bot: Alert: Unusual auth activity - token svc-ml-ingest-089a used from 3 distinct external IPs in the last 15m :rotating_light:
alyssa: ugh, that token should've been revoked when ml-ingest was decommed last quarter
jorge: confirmed, svc-ml-ingest was decommissioned 2025-10-02. Token rotation policy didn't catch it apparently :grimace:
mohammad: running a quick query to enumerate usage and write targets now
mohammad: ```bash
# query logs for that token
curl -s 'https://logs.internal/query?token=svc-ml-ingest-089a&last=24h' | jq '.hits[] | {ts, ip, path, status}'
```
ops-bot: Query returned 18 hits, most to /api/v1/ingest/metrics, 3 unique external IPs: 18.204.12.5, 54.239.23.98, 3.122.77.11
sophie: any signs of writes that affected customer data?
jorge: checking DB writes now, running a narrow scan on ingest_queue for those timestamps
jorge: ```sql
select id, source, created_at from ingest_queue where created_at > '2026-03-19T00:00:00Z' and source = 'ml-ingest';
```
jorge: results look internal-only, no customer org ids in payloads, majority are metrics pings
eva: good, still we should contain asap. can someone revoke the token and add the IPs to denylist?
mohammad: revoking token with authctl now
mohammad: ```bash
# revoke token
authctl revoke svc-ml-ingest-089a --force && authctl verify svc-ml-ingest-089a || echo revoked
```
mohammad: revoke output: revoked, verification failed as expected :white_check_mark:
alyssa: thanks. adding the three IPs to denylist at edge and WAF rules in case token was replayed elsewhere
ops-bot: WAF rule updated, IPs blocked globally
sophie: who touched the token originally? need to track genesis and TTL gaps. repo shows it was created by infra-bot during an old deploy pipeline
jorge: infra-bot created it in 2024, KMS wrapping was not enforced for service tokens back then. It never had an expiry set
eva: so root cause = orphaned long-lived token + missing TTL + no enforcement of KMS wrapping for service tokens
alyssa: next actions: 1) confirm no customer impact 2) rotate any related keys 3) add monitoring for decommed service token usage 4) short-term blocklist + revoke done
sophie: i've opened INFSEC-2021 in Jira to track follow-ups and postmortem, assigning to infra and platform teams
sophie: suggested remediation items in ticket: enforce token TTLs, require KMS-wrapped service tokens, add a daily job that flags tokens tied to decommissioned services, add alert for tokens >90d active
jorge: also recommend RBAC change: disallow creation of long-lived tokens by bots without owner approval workflow
mohammad: adding audit log retention check — we need guaranteed logs for 365 days for these auth events. opening a ticket for log retention config
eva: communication plan: internal only for now, no customer notification required since no customer data touched. if anything changes, we'll escalate to legal and notify affected customers within 72h
alyssa: timeline for post-incident: quick blameless sync tomorrow 10:30am, invite infra, security, platform, product ops, and compliance
jorge: will prepare a short forensic summary with timestamps, IPs, and the revocation proof for the sync
mohammad: adding a monitoring rule now: detect token use where token_meta.status = decommissioned OR token_age > 90d
mohammad: rule snippet: ```sql
select token, count(*) from auth_events where (service_status = 'decommissioned' or token_age_days > 90) group by token having count(*) > 0
```
sophie: great. assign owners in INFSEC-2021 and set SLA for remediation to 72h
eva: we should also push a small infra change: new tokens must be KMS-encrypted and created with expiry metadata enforced by token service
alyssa: note for postmortem: add automated revoke on service decommission to the decomm pipeline
jorge: confirmed, i will add the revoke hook and unit tests in the decomm workflow PR
security-bot: Summary: token svc-ml-ingest-089a revoked at 1769994400, 18 hits in last 24h, no customer data writes observed, IPs denylisted, Jira INFSEC-2021 opened, follow-up actions assigned
sophie: thanks team. keep updates in the ticket, close this thread after the postmortem is scheduled :eyes:
